body_text:
The series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n$ converges to $S$ if the
sequence of partial sums $s_N=\sum_{n=0}^{N}a_n$ converges to
$S$. Thus an infinite sum is defined through a limit of finite
sums. Necessarily $a_n\to0$, but this condition is not
sufficient for convergence.
